answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake subject to quadratic slashing during each epoch pulse. When an adversary attempts to spawn multiple identities, cryptographic stake burning scales superlinearly: minting n counterfeit identities incurs an umber ash penalty of O(n^2.5) burned collateral. This severe economic friction renders mass identity forgery an unaffordable fable while honest single-node agents thrive.
